data: Amazon (AMZN) delivered a strong fiscal 2025, with revenue rising 12.4% to $716.9 billion from $638.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Profitability improved faster than the top line. Net income grew 31.1% to $77.7 billion in fiscal 2025, up from $59.2 billion a year earlier, which points to meaningful operating leverage across the business. Cash generation was similarly robust: operating cash flow reached $139.5 billion in fiscal 2025 against $115.9 billion in fiscal 2024. Cash and cash equivalents ended fiscal 2025 at $86.8 billion, compared with $78.8 billion in fiscal 2024. The balance sheet expanded sharply, with total assets climbing to $818.0 billion in fiscal 2025 from $624.9 billion. Total liabilities rose more slowly, to $407.0 billion from $338.9 billion, so the company's equity cushion widened. We view the combination of accelerating earnings and rising cash flow as constructive for the shares.
